description: Tells a Codex session what is waiting on the backchannel when it starts and when it stops; the backchannel server then wakes the session itself when something arrives.

hooks.command: uv run --quiet --project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" --no-config --locked --no-dev backchannel hook session-start codex
uv run --quiet --project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" --no-config --locked --no-dev backchannel hook stop codex
